title: Get Microsoft Office for life for a one-time fee, just $50
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Add Microsoft Office 2024 to your virtual machine with this lifetime license, on sale now for just $49.97 (reg. $249.99).

Plenty of Mac users still need the Windows build of Microsoft Office, whether a job requires it or you just need an app like Access that never came to macOS. Renting it through a Microsoft 365 plan means a charge every month with no finish line. If you want a simpler solution, you can get Microsoft Office 2024 for only $49.97 (reg. $249.99).

This version installs Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, OneNote, and Access in your Windows environment, all from one purchase tied to a single machine. Office 2024 runs as a perpetual release, so what you buy is what you get, and no random update from Microsoft is going to change that. A built-in dark mode makes long spreadsheet or writing sessions easier on the eyes, and these apps run on minimal hardware, so they work great in a virtual machine.

Why pay $99.99 for Microsoft 365 when you can get lifetime access to the same apps for a one-time fee.

Get a Microsoft Office 2024 Pro Plus Lifetime License for $49.97.
